items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: we went to -- after we did two months, May and June, two months, then we went to Pollard had an engagement in Ostend in a cabaret... the leader, Pollard, he got into trouble too. After we finished, we had enough money to stay around on vacation

ctx.x: That is what happened, the Europeans knew about you and it was easy to get work there?
Oh yes, sure. And we went to -- after we did two months, May and June, two months, then we went to Pollard had an engagement in Ostend in a cabaret, Maxim's Cabaret, which did not do so well.
